method.score: activity × clear sky × darkness × moon & lights
method.clear_definition: at least 2 consecutive dark hours with cloud cover ≤ 40%

weekly.geomagnetic: Geomagnetic field activity is likely to reach G1 (Minor) storm levels on 19-20 Oct and 31 Oct-01 Nov, with active conditions likely on 21 and 24 Oct and 09 Nov, due to CH HSS influences. Quiet and quiet to unsettled levels are expected to prevail throughout the remainder of the outlook period.

three_day.rationale: No G1 (Minor) or greater geomagnetic storms are expected through 24 Oct, though a negative polarity CH HSS is anticipated to produce a disturbed near-Earth environment on 24 Oct.
three_day.summary: The greatest expected 3 hr Kp for Oct 22-Oct 24 2026 is 4.33 (below NOAA Scale levels)
